name: DEM BONES
source: No public-domain score of DEM BONES found to read the melody from.
reviewNotes: No melody yet: no public-domain score of the 1928 song could be found to read it from (IMSLP lists only a 2017 CC BY arrangement by Adam Cuerden, behind IMSLP's bot check; Mutopia, the Internet Archive and abcnotation have none). Add the melody from a printed source (key, time, melody), then publish the hymn dem-bones.json. The credit and the 1928 date are from Wikipedia and IMSLP's work page ('Year of First Publication: 1928'), not from a copy of the song; the well-known version whose verse climbs a half step on each 'bone' line may be a later arrangement (Fred Waring, the Delta Rhythm Boys) and still in copyright — check before using it.
